name: Lancet
description: Gothic two-light windows in a pale stone wall: twin pointed lancets of deep stained glass under a quatrefoil in the window head.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { --q: @p(var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5), var(--color6)); background: radial-gradient(6% 6% at 44.6% 18%, @var(--q) 100%, transparent 100%), radial-gradient(6% 6% at 55.4% 18%, @var(--q) 100%, transparent 100%), radial-gradient(6% 6% at 50% 12.6%, @var(--q) 100%, transparent 100%), radial-gradient(6% 6% at 50% 23.4%, @var(--q) 100%, transparent 100%), radial-gradient(13.8% 13.8% at 50% 18%, transparent 84%, var(--color2) 84% 100%, transparent 100%); :before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5), var(--color6)); -webkit-clip-path: @var(--ll); clip-path: @var(--ll); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5), var(--color6)); -webkit-clip-path: @var(--lr); clip-path: @var(--lr); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
